name: Jamil Khan
bio: Jamil Khan founded Green Plus EXIM in 2000 and has led the company's sourcing and export operations across fresh produce, grains, seafood, animal feed and fertilizers since. His writing on this site draws on day-to-day work with buyers, sourcing partners and shipping lines. [Bio to be confirmed by the owner — see OWNER_TODO.md]

name: Green Plus EXIM Editorial Team
bio: Our editorial team researches and fact-checks the trade data, specifications and market information published on this site, working from public trade-data sources (India Dept. of Commerce TradeStat, APEDA AgriExchange, UN Comtrade, ITC Trade Map and others cited on each page) and input from our sourcing and export operations team.
